question_cues.description: Cues in the visible question about U.S. Treasury and official financial records. external_time_series: needs an official time-series value that may not be in the provided pages (for example an actual published rate or series observation). period_range: spans several months, quarters, or years, or an inclusive date range. unit_or_currency_conversion: converts currencies, exchange rates, or scales (thousands, millions, billions). treasury_financing: concerns Treasury offerings, auctions, tenders, subscriptions, refunding, or new cash. derived_comparison: asks for a change, difference, gap, share, ratio, or percent of a total. statistical_calculation: asks for a standard deviation, z-score, regression, correlation, growth rate, CAGR, median, mean, smoothing, or forecast. multi_stage_lookup: one lookup determines the period or entity for a second lookup. security_quotation: concerns bond, note, or bill price quotations or yields. Several cues may apply; use an empty list if none is recognized.
